review_events.rejection_comment: (1) map Outlet Name to entity.trading_name as well - the ontology allows multiple trading names, one observation each, and outlet-level names are this source's main value for downstream name matching; (2) address.full evidence must state the values are often shopping-centre names rather than street addresses, and its confidence should drop to about 0.6; (3) the double-scheme website values (http://https://) and the 'Pty Ltd' names inside Trading Name are source dirt carried faithfully - leave them as they are.
